title: He Paid for a Hit... The Hitman Was a Cop

scenes.line: Prosecutors say he paid $80,000 for a murder... and the hitman was a cop.
Ross Ulbricht ran Silk Road, the biggest dark web market on Earth.
He believed a worker stole his bitcoin, so he hired a hitman called Nob.
Nob was a DEA agent. The photos were staged. The victim was alive.
On Oct 2, 2013, the FBI shut Silk Road down and bitcoin crashed to $85.
He got life in prison. And the agent who stole the coins? He went to prison too.

description: 2013: Silk Road boss Ross Ulbricht believed a worker had stolen his bitcoin. Prosecutors say he paid a hitman called Nob $80,000. Nob was DEA agent Carl Force, the photos were staged and the worker was alive. Oct 2, 2013: the FBI shut Silk Road down and BTC fell to about $85 on Bitstamp. Ulbricht got life in 2015 (pardoned in January 2025); both corrupt agents went to prison. The murder-for-hire allegation was never tried in court.
pinned: Craziest plot twist in crypto history? Tell me a crazier one 👇
